newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Turnover, prices drift low on Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Turnover, prices drift low on Bucharest bourse.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest bourse on Thursday sagged to 39 million lei, or less than half the previous session's level, as investors lost interest ahead of Sunday's general elections, traders said.
Two independent indices touched year lows as most share prices nudged down.
Azomures SA fertiliser maker took 71 percent of Thursday's turnover and closed 100 lei weaker at 10,300.

"Investors will be waiting for polls results next week, so I see no reinvigoration of trading. They will show some interest in newcomer Impact, but next week will be a probing week for the new stock," one trader said.
The exchange announced on Wednesday private construction company Impact SA would be joining the other 13 traded stocks -- of which only one is privately held -- next Thursday.
Brokers say Impact will probably become an attractive stock as it is a private company operating in a sector which they say has great potential.

Two unofficial value-weighted indexes -- the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA securities, and the BIG of Bucharest Investment Group -- dropped by 1.9 percent from the previous session to 285.3 points and 284.29 points respectively.
Prices are on MRRO and MRRP.
